create_optimizer_madgrad: create a MADGRAD optimizer instance with custom learning rate and momentum for model training
step_optimizer_madgrad: perform a single optimization step using the MADGRAD optimizer to update model parameters
configure_momentum_madgrad: configure the MADGRAD optimizer with momentum values in the range [0,1) for stochastic optimization
enable_decoupled_decay_madgrad: enable AdamW style decoupled weight decay on the MADGRAD optimizer for better regularization
check_fp16_support_madgrad: check if the MADGRAD optimizer supports memory efficient fp16 and flat params for GPU training
